description: A fast PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite TUI written in Rust - driver-less, vim-first, with ER diagrams
notes: sabiql shells out to the database's own client: install psql, mysql or sqlite3 and put it on PATH.
Connection profiles live outside the Scoop app directory and survive updates:
%APPDATA%\sabiql = connections.toml (passwords are stored in plain text).
'scoop uninstall sabiql' does not remove them; delete those folders manually for a full cleanup.
